q: 选存储引擎 / 索引结构时，最该先问自己的一组问题是？
options: 内存/磁盘 · 读/写 · 等值/范围 · 超不超 RAM · 要不要持久化
用什么编程语言 · 团队多大 · 预算多少
先决定 NoSQL 还是 SQL，再把它的特性全背下来
无脑默认 Postgres，不用分析
why: 选存储结构不用背——先问五个问题就定：①内存还是磁盘 ②读多还是写多 ③只等值还是要范围 ④会不会超过 RAM ⑤要不要持久化。三大核心结构：哈希表（O(1) 只等值，内存）、B 树（读优化+范围，磁盘）、LSM 树（写优化，日志结构 memtable→SSTable→compaction）。这是所有索引/引擎选型卡的总纲。
why_en: You don't memorize storage choices — you ask five questions: (1) memory or disk, (2) read- or write-heavy, (3) exact-match only or need range/sort, (4) will data exceed RAM, (5) need durability. Three core structures: hash table (O(1) exact-match, in-memory), B-tree (read-optimized + range, on disk), and LSM tree (write-optimized, log-structured). This is the master map behind every index/engine card.

rows: O(1) 只等值·无范围（内存）
读优化·原地更新·范围+排序（磁盘）

q: 索引对内存占用的实际影响，下面哪个判断最准确？
options: 多一个索引，内存占用就直接翻一倍
索引完全不占用任何内存空间
内存影响是索引所有代价里最致命的
影响常被夸大：缓冲池管理已很智能，但仍要监控索引使用
why: 这题只在说「内存」这一种代价，别和另两种混了。加索引其实有三种代价：①写变慢——每次增删改都要顺带维护这个索引（写放大），这才是主要代价；②占磁盘——索引是一份独立的 B 树结构；③占内存——就是本题，常被高估：缓冲池(buffer pool)是 LRU 缓存，只把「热」页留在内存，冷索引躺在盘上几乎不占 RAM，不会「翻一倍」。所以要防的不是内存，而是「加了一堆没人查、却拖慢每次写」的索引 → 监控使用率、删掉无用索引。
why_en: This card is only about the MEMORY cost — don't conflate it with the other two. An index has three costs: (1) slower writes — every insert/update/delete must maintain it (write amplification), the main cost; (2) extra disk — a separate B-tree structure; (3) memory — the topic here, and the overhyped one: the buffer pool is an LRU cache that keeps only hot pages, so cold indexes barely occupy RAM (no doubling). The real danger is unused indexes that slow every write for zero read benefit — monitor and drop them.
options_en: Adding one more index simply doubles memory usage.
Indexes take up no memory at all.
Memory impact is the single most fatal cost of indexes.
The impact is often overblown thanks to smart buffer pool management, but you should still monitor index usage.

why: O(log n) 只说明很快找到“哪一页要改”。真正贵的是后半段：把散落在磁盘/SSD 各处的小页读进缓存、改成脏页、之后再刷回去；页满了还可能 split。十万级写入会把这些小而分散的页操作放大成随机 I/O 瓶颈。
why_en: O(log n) only means the database quickly finds which page to change. At very high write rates, those scattered page operations become the random I/O bottleneck.

why: 关键：B 树的 O(log n) 是个极小的数——每个节点是一页、装几百个 key，所以几十亿行也就 3–4 层（见表）。加上真正的成本是磁盘 I/O 不是比较次数、顶层又几乎都在缓存，所以等值查找 B 树只比 hash 慢一丝丝，却白送范围和排序。因此 Postgres 说哈希「解决的是我们很少遇到的问题」。
why_en: A B-tree's O(log n) is tiny: each node is a page holding hundreds of keys, so even billions of rows are only 3–4 levels deep. Since the real cost is disk I/O (not comparisons) and the top levels stay cached, equality lookups are only marginally slower than a hash — but you also get range and sort for free. Hence Postgres calls hash indexes a solution to a problem we rarely have.

q: 正确的默认决策流是？

不管什么场景都上 Elasticsearch
默认 B 树；例外：邻近用地理索引，全文用倒排
why: 拿不准就 B 树（等值+范围通吃、各数据库的默认）；空间数据换 geohash 系空间索引，大规模文本搜索换倒排索引。这三板斧覆盖绝大多数索引问题。
why_en: Default to B-trees, switch to a geospatial index like geohash for lat-lng proximity, and use an inverted index for full-text search.
whenOtherWins: 极端写入摄入（指标、日志、IoT）时再引入 LSM 存储引擎的讨论；纯内存等值查找才轮到哈希结构。

termDefinitions.meaning: 理解二维空间邻近关系的索引，如 geohash、四叉树、R 树。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A geospatial index understands 2D proximity, implemented via approaches like geohash, quadtrees, or R-trees.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把「词 → 包含它的文档列表」反向存储的索引，支撑全文搜索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index stores a mapping from each word to the list of documents containing it, powering full-text search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种自平衡的多路搜索树，节点可以有多个子节点，保持数据有序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A B-tree is a self-balancing multi-way search tree that keeps data sorted with many children per node.
